features.feature: Frozen review inventory epoch is a canonical signed gate-consumed fact bound to story, round, cutoff, scope, lanes, waves, host and prompt identities
Operator can begin, inspect, finalize or cancel an epoch and status exposes blockers plus exactly one next command
features.source: understanding.json outcome; CHK-001 userSees and verificationIntent

features.feature: OPEN epoch blocks review-subject material mutation at handlers, supported host hooks, commit guards and lifecycle transitions
Bypassed drift invalidates the epoch, makes old verdicts advisory and provides an auditable cancel or DEV recovery path
All scope and risk selected lanes plus completeness critic must terminate on one unchanged cutoff with bounded read or coverage evidence
Only a zero-new-verified-finding saturation wave may finalize; timeout, missing output, duplicate identity or budget exhaustion cannot manufacture PASS
features.source: background.md; CHK-003 edge and adversarial intents

features.feature: A finalized receipt authorizes exactly one aggregated remediation DEV transition and never authorizes TEST or certifies defective material
Repaired material requires fresh dependency-closure impacted lanes, preserving full lane and host assurance when scope cannot be proven narrow
The historical round-2-plus one-receipt sufficiency shortcut must be removed wherever it can claim final review completeness
B-cdf6 RR-043 through RR-051 replay must reduce mutation-driven redispatches from at least five to zero under explicit deterministic thresholds
Efficiency cannot reduce required reviewer lanes, host diversity, freshness, completeness critic or historical critical/high detection
Every new gate fact must have both prompt guidance and mechanical handler or gate enforcement plus process-fact registry verification
features.source: AGENTS.md process-fact dual contract; understanding.json constraints
